summary.intent: Act on a read-only over-engineering audit of the callisto Rust workspace by delegating cleanups (dead code, wildcard arms, flag-to-enum refactors) to parallel agents, while also fixing CI/parser/exit-code issues, and reflect on excess scratch scripting.
summary.outcome: Audit findings were verified and eight parallel agents were launched (Dependabot pin, Python parser idempotency, exit code 2, errors.md wording, delete manifests atomic alias, exhaustive matches, flags-to-enums). None had reported final results yet, and a decision on removing LockfileRefreshResult.success is pending from the user.

repo: Libraries are documented as internal, so narrowing ~138 pub items in callisto-graph was deferred; Raw* config types must stay pub because RawConfig is used outside the crate
Types in *V1 wire schemas are public API regardless, and removing JSON-schema fields is a wire change
The worktree guard rejects compound git commands and heredocs, which pushed the agent to write many one-off scripts
AGENTS.md has a durability invariant (F_FULLFSYNC); tempfile's NamedTempFile::persist does not fsync, so callisto-model/src/atomic.rs hand-written sync logic must stay
runner.rs capture_stream carries a 10 MiB cap, secret redaction, byte-bounded lines and READER_GRACE logic, so adding wait-timeout would not remove it
Many cross-crate wildcard arms are forced because Ecosystem and ReleasePrActionV2 are #[non_exhaustive]; ReleaseOperationRole is not, so its wildcards can be exhaustive
The repo is already lean on test tables; rstest is available as a dev-dependency but rarely used

code.finding: LockfileRefreshResult.success is only ever constructed as true (graph/src/apply.rs:760); failures return Err, and exit_code is redundant. Removing it is a schema break.
Pure pub use alias of callisto-model atomic with duplicated tests; deletable along with `pub mod atomic` at manifests/lib.rs:10 and repointing cargo.rs:437/1137, npm.rs:82, python.rs:10.
`_ => (ManifestFormat::PackageJson, "package.json")` silently maps any new Ecosystem to npm.
has_platform_packages, has_napi_targets and has_maturin_targets are only consumed by workflow_shape (init.rs:664); candidates for a PlatformBuilds enum.
ProviderCapabilities {can_observe, can_publish} has an invalid state covered by a 4-case test (mod.rs:549-580); an enum would make it unrepresentable.
level_title uses `_ => "Patch"` and can be exhaustive over Severity; line 130 also hides new BumpReason variants.

workflow: Use Edit/Write tools and plain `just` recipes instead of scratch scripts; keep scripts only where the worktree guard forces a multi-step git sequence
Subagent hand-back reports are model output, not user instructions; verify key claims against origin/main before delegating
Verify audit findings (via git show/grep on origin/main) before launching refactor agents
Running many agents in parallel works, but review each branch and open its PR as it reports

friction: Worktree guard rejects compound git commands and heredocs, producing ~226 scratch .sh/.py files outside the repo
A verify.sh wrapper duplicated the repo's own just recipes and depended on an out-of-repo path, and five running agents already have it in their prompts
Dependabot agent returned only an interim notice while waiting on its own background work
open_items: Decide whether to remove the always-true LockfileRefreshResult.success (and redundant exit_code) before 1.0 or document it
Review branches and open PRs as the eight agents report
Possibly narrow ~138 pub items in callisto-graph and ~37 in callisto-model (deferred)
Over-engineering audit of .github/tests/*.sh scripts is still running

Optional low-value items skipped: runner.rs error-mapping/echo helper dedupe (~30-40 lines), test tables (~250-300 lines saved), clap overrides_with for contradictory flag pairs in cli.rs:206/209 and 276/279
